rules.text: rotli is a warm, local-first Mac menu-bar notes app — your NOTES FOLDER is a memex (one folder: notes · chats · knowledge · files). THREE fronts: Inbox (emails) · Chat (AI chats) · Notes (the note system — Capture · the AI-organized 'brain' areas · Storage · Boards). Stack: Tauri (Rust shell in src-tauri/) + React + Vite + TypeScript, Bun runtime (one bun.lock, bunfig.toml). The conceptual model + vocabulary is docs/model.md — defer to it.

The user's notes are PLAIN MARKDOWN files they own, in their notes folder — a memex by default (the plain-start default is ~/Documents/rotli); folders on disk = folders in the sidebar. The app's own state lives in a sibling `.rotli/` (settings · view state · index) — deletable with no data loss. The files are the source of truth; never lock notes into a proprietary store.

Low-pulse by design: no dock icon, no ⌘Tab entry, no badges/pings; summon with ⌥Space, dismiss and it's gone. Formatting/typography (Aa) is a RENDER layer — never written into the user's markdown files.

Stack discipline: Bun (one lockfile), TypeScript strict, React + Vite frontend, Tauri (Rust) shell. Dev: `bun run dev` (web) / `bun run tauri dev` (app). Run `bun run check` (and `bun run check:hex` for brand colors) before calling work done.

rotli READS the whole memex and WRITES only its owned surfaces per the v3.6 contract: chats/ (AI chats), inbox.md (⌥C captures), and wiki/_inbox/ NOTE STAGING (new notes land there with frontmatter id/owner/created/updated/shelf/reach + blank AI metadata; a later local-LLM files them to wiki/<area>/ — the 'brain'). It NEVER writes history/ (Breve's), identity/ or personality/ (the former self/), MAP, or the curated rest of wiki/ — refused at both the TS canWrite gate and the Rust is_writable guard. Contract band [3.4, 3.6]. VOCAB (see docs/model.md): your NOTES FOLDER is a memex (one corpus.json; one memex by default — 'corpus' is internal, never user-facing). The 'BRAIN' = the AI-organized wiki areas INSIDE Notes (filed by metadata), NOT a connected memex. A SECOND memex is a 'linked library' (advanced; the active one is writable per its perms). Storage = the memex storage/ (binaries via storage: links; a dropped file routes there). Access is metadata (note reach/owner + a per-note 'locked' flag the AI filer must respect + the local/open/secure mode). Mirror-not-import the boundary, exactly like Breve. See docs/model.md + ~/memex-vault/STRUCTURE.md (v3.6) + memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/memex-integration.

'Everything has a chat' — any object can carry a chat (chats/<slug>.md, attachedTo: [[note]]). The Convex + CRDT multi-device sync is a DESIGN (memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/sync-design), NOT yet wired — today's build is local-first, single-device (Stage 1, Phases 0–1c).

Docs live in docs/; the brand kit + brand home live in smLab (apps/rotli + brand/kits/rotli). Change code that a doc describes → update the doc (+ a CHANGELOG entry) in the same commit — see the global DOCS domain.

decisions.decision: Notes are plain markdown files the user owns in ~/Documents/rotli/; the app keeps only derived state in a sibling .rotli/ (deletable without data loss).
decisions.rationale: Local-first, no lock-in: files openable in any editor, backable-up, forever. The app is 'a warm window onto them,' not their owner.
